segments.contextAfter: With Streamlined Purchasing turned off, your app has the opportunity to perform processing related to the win-back offer before it enables the customer to complete the purchase. The workflow starts when the customer initiates the purchase outside of your app. The system prompts them to install the app if it isn’t already installed. Your app receives a_ _purchase intent in the [`intents`](purchaseintent/intents.md) sequence, instead of a transaction, and must use the [`PurchaseIntent`](purchaseintent.md) API to complete the purchase.
